say:1:1730180901:1.text: Yes, I fought the Graveborn of Bantus in my youth.
say:1:1730180901:1.source_cn: 是的，我年轻时和班题斯那帮亡灵拼过命。
say:1:1730180901:1.male: Yes, I fought the Graveborn of Bantus in my youth.
say:1:1730180901:1.female: Yes, I fought the Graveborn of Bantus in my youth.

say:2:1730180902:1.text: The empire's prosperity today is built on hard-won peace.
say:2:1730180902:1.source_cn: 耀光帝国能有现在的繁华，全靠着来之不易的和平。
say:2:1730180902:1.male: The empire's prosperity today is built on hard-won peace.
say:2:1730180902:1.female: The empire's prosperity today is built on hard-won peace.

say:3:1730180903:1.text: It falls to youngsters like you to keep the peace...
say:3:1730180903:1.source_cn: 你们年轻人，可要替我守好……
say:3:1730180903:1.male: It falls to youngsters like you to keep the peace...
say:3:1730180903:1.female: It falls to youngsters like you to keep the peace...
